reason: In services/src/main/java/org/keycloak/services/resources/admin/permissions/GroupPermissionsV2.java:121-125, getGroupIdsWithViewPermission() passes groupResource.getId() (the generated authorization resource ID) to hasPermission() and adds it to granted, even though group resources store the group ID in resource.getName() (AdminPermissionsSchema.java:103-118) and hasPermission() looks up resources via resourceStore.findByName(server, groupId) (GroupPermissionsV2.java:141). Consequently, the per-group resource lookup fails and any returned IDs are authorization resource IDs rather than Keycloak group IDs expected by user filtering and counts in UsersResource.java:397,422,427,442.
